why: Item r/traaaaaaannnnnnnnnns/T2-08783 mixes negotiated crossings with unilateral restraint, so telling T3-010's agreed lines apart from T3-024's unasked sparing is the batch's hardest call.

why.T3-006: The concepts are calls, plans or reports of attacks meant to destroy or erase named other works (blue corner, French/German/Swiss flags, Helix, One Punch Man, everything at coordinates), i.e. calling to deface rivals' work, not spreading a colour (T3-171).

why.T3-174: Members of the erasure cause profess loyalty to it with hails, vows, names and doctrine ('Make r/place white again', 'PURGE THE HUE-ETICS', 'We are... THE WHITE KNIGHTS', 'default it to emptiness'), i.e. the colour-as-cause as faith, not its spread (T3-171).

why.T3-010: Concepts settle where the flag meets neighbours: the ace flag meeting without overlap, ownership of the r/ainbowroad crossing, permission to draw over a segment, action on borders.
why.T3-024: Other concepts keep the flag off others' art by the room's own choice: letting others have their art, being against destroying existing art, not attacking the rainbow road, refusing to co-opt other pieces.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-010 alone carries the negotiated crossings and lines but not the room's unasked restraint toward neighbours' art (letting others have their art, refusing to destroy it).
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: The gate of T3-024 is satisfied by restraint kept by the room's own choice, e.g. C1375622 'letting other people have theirs' and C0884535 'against destroying existing art', which is not a settled line.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-024; dropping it would lose the room's unilateral sparing of neighbours that negotiated crossings do not capture.

why.T3-031: The room presses its own jokes, names and reaction formats into canvas work (draw a pickle, the flag 'is a cross', r/place reaction posts, 'Trans Continental Railroad', Trans Womyn/Men of r/place), i.e. its running in-jokes, not a clash retold as fandom lore (T3-135).

why.T3-085: The single concept anticipates the flag being complained about for taking too much space, i.e. weighing the room's mark against others on the canvas by size/space ('too big', a claim to space), the nearest fit to flags called too big.

why.T3-014: The room sets up a Discord, posts invites and sends members there to coordinate and to battlestations, i.e. canvas planning moved into a chat outside the thread.

why.T3-174: The concepts are hails, vows, slogans and doctrine professing loyalty to the white/erasure cause, i.e. loyalty to a colour-as-cause rather than spreading it (T3-171).

why.T3-038: The concepts place the flag and report its state: started writing 'Trans lives matter', joining the writing, trying to write trans, 'it will grow', lengthening it.
why.T3-002: Other concepts call members in to come and place: recruiting to the trans army, asking someone to continue the writing, 'Make it happen'.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-038 carries the building and its progress but not the room's explicit calls for hands to come and place.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: The gate of T3-002 is satisfied by recruitment of placers, e.g. C0661436 'Join us, soldier! Fight in the trans army' and C0804558 asking someone to continue the writing.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-002; dropping it would lose the calls that bring new hands to the build.

why.T3-005: An attack (the Void, red invaders, the black plague) on the room's work and the room's rallying answer: 'Defend the flag', 'We're losing the fight', calls to arms, 'another wave comes'.

why.T3-009: The concepts mark the room's flag as achieved and celebrate it: 'made it to the edge', 'we win', 'The TransFlag is immovable', 'span the width'. Nearest T3-104 is cheering builders, but the object here is the work, not the placers.

why.T3-164: Members find support, visibility and comfort through the flag: 'I feel less alone', 'so many different people support', 'made me feel better', proof the world is not going backwards.

why.T3-105: The room keeps the finished spot as a record: 'caught a screenshot of our spot at its most perfect', with thanks for cropping and the phone detail, i.e. saving the work as it stood.

why.T3-043: The concepts credit and thank those who made the work: 'grateful to everyone who worked on this', thanks to whoever finished the avacado, 'I helped build this... we all did'.
why.T3-073: Other concepts recount what happened to the work: the flag spanning the canvas and being immortalised, a quarter destroyed, the spying, laughing at failed break-throughs.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-043 carries the thanks and credit but not the recounting of what befell the work (destruction, spying, the span).
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: The gate of T3-073 is satisfied by post-close accounts of what happened to the work, e.g. C1366080 recounting the flag spanning the canvas and C0526754 a quarter destroyed.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-073; dropping it would lose the retelling of the work's fate that carries the label's 'retelling the win'.

why.T3-021: The concepts watch and repair the flag's pixels: patching spots, fixing the red dot, fixing stray pixels all night, cleaning up, fixing a vandalised pixel.
why.T3-008: Other concepts contact individual miscolorers: checking the profiles of people who miscolor, messaging those dotting the flag to ask why.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-021 carries the pixel repair but not the room's contact with the individual people changing the pixels.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: The gate of T3-008 is satisfied by singling out and messaging individual placers, e.g. C1480760 'I actually messaged a bunch of them' and C1158877 checking miscolorers' profiles.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-008; dropping it would lose the social correction of individuals that the note contrasts with pixel work.
